newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bremen coffee prices rise in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Bremen coffee prices rise in quiet trade.

text.p: Price rises in Bremen arabicas by $9-11 on the week per 50 kg fob reflected a two-day run-up in futures, although New York was last headed lower.
Dealings were generally thin but coffee roasters were looking for Central Americans against the Dec and March arabica futures contract, which offered savings over nearby Sept.
Traders said consumers were well covered with Brazils for Sept/Nov while Colombians were in demand for Oct/Dec.
The Kenyan fly crop auctions brought this origin back into the market, albeit with lower qualities than last seen.
Buyers took some New Guinean, Burundian and Rwandan coffee.
